subject: Urgent: interview today — building alarm, short phone option
messages:
From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@gmail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Interview today — urgent: building alarm + phone low

Hi Markus / Laura,

I’m really sorry to do this last minute — at 7:45am our building’s fire alarm went off and we were evacuated. I’m outside now and my phone is down to about 5% (charging slowly in the lobby). I don’t think I’ll be able to join the 9:00am Zoom for the onsite-style interview as planned.

If there’s any flexibility, I can: 
- hop on a 20–25 minute phone call at ~9:15am (I’ll keep it brief), or
- record a quick 5–8 minute voice note / short screen recording of the coding exercise environment if that helps, or
- reschedule the session later today/tomorrow.

My phone (temporary) is +1 (415) 555-0142 — I’ll keep it on and near a charger. I attached my resume in case it helps.

So sorry about the disruption. Please let me know what you’d prefer and I’ll make it work.

Thanks,
Sofia Martinez
(available via email until battery dies)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@gmail.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview today — urgent: building alarm + phone low

Hi Sofia — thanks for the quick note and glad you’re safe. No worries about the alarm.

We can make a short plan so we don’t lose the day: Mina is available for a 25-minute phone screen at 9:15am to cover the coding exercise basics and behavioral questions. We can reschedule the system-design portion for later this week. If your phone dies before then, replying with a 1–2 minute voice note is also totally fine — we’ll accept that and follow up.

Proposed:
- 9:15–9:40am phone screen with Mina (we’ll call +1 (415) 555-0142)
- Reschedule system design for 1 hour later this week (Laura to propose slots)

If you prefer a recorded screen + voice walkthrough instead of live, say the word and we’ll give you a private code exercise link with instructions.

Zoom remains the original meeting but we’ll default to phone. I’ll update your calendar and share the new Zoom fallback link.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Thanks for the fast triage, Laura. Quick notes for coverage: 

- Mina: please take the 9:15am 25-min phone slot. Focus on the coding exercise (3 small algorithmic questions) and the brief behavioral questions. We don’t need the system-design part today.
- Dylan: please hold your 45-minute block as backup in case we want to do a short live design later today; I’ll ping you if we try to expand.
- If Sofia’s phone dies mid-call, ask her to send a 1–2 minute voice note summarizing her approach; that will be fine for us to evaluate and we can follow up asynchronously.
- If Mina feels we need more time, we’ll schedule a 30–45 minute follow-up later this week (Laura will send availability).

Also — candidate has attached resume; keep that in the folder: Sofia_Martinez_resume.pdf.

Thanks team.
Markus Klein

markus.klein@redwood.com
